segments.text: a twelve-year-old who can barely swim, alone in the sea at night, holding a piece of a plane.
She just found herself in the water. She hears voices calling in the dark, but she can't see anyone.
The waves are high. She can't climb onto the wreckage, so she just holds on. Hour after hour. All night. Then all morning.
Then, a boat. The crew throw her a life ring. In those waves, she can't reach it.
So one sailor jumps in after her. On deck: blankets, and warm, sweet water. She's alive.
But she thinks she just fell out of the plane, and that her mother landed safely without her.
